description: Source code for the LDAP Wizard component in Mattermost's admin console, implementing LDAP configuration UI with multiple settings sections, test result handling, and save logic.

methods.name: buildTextSetting
methods.description: Builds a text input setting component with test result display.

methods.name: buildBoolSetting
methods.description: Builds a boolean toggle setting component.

methods.name: buildDropdownSetting
methods.description: Builds a dropdown selection setting component.

methods.name: buildButtonSetting
methods.description: Builds a button setting component, including test actions.

methods.name: buildJobsTableSetting
methods.description: Builds a jobs table setting component.

methods.name: fileUploadSetstate
methods.description: Updates state for file upload setting with filename and error message.

methods.name: buildFileUploadSetting
methods.description: Builds a file upload setting component.

methods.name: buildCustomSetting
methods.description: Builds a custom setting component.

methods.name: buildExpandableSetting
methods.description: Builds an expandable setting component containing sub-settings.

methods.name: nullFunction
methods.description: Placeholder function returning null for unsupported setting types.

methods.name: buildSettingFunctions
methods.description: Mapping of setting types to their builder functions.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Determines if a setting should be disabled based on its isDisabled property.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Determines if a setting should be hidden based on its isHidden property.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title/header of the LDAP Wizard.

methods.name: doSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving config and executing registered save actions.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change events for settings, updates state, and optionally triggers submit.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submit event, manages save process and error handling.

methods.name: unRegisterSaveAction
methods.description: Removes a save action from the list of registered save actions.

methods.name: registerSaveAction
methods.description: Adds a save action to the list of registered save actions.

methods.name: setSaveNeeded
methods.description: Marks the form as needing save.

methods.name: cancelSubmit
methods.description: Cancels the confirmation dialog for submitting.

methods.name: canSave
methods.description: Validates whether the form can be saved based on current settings.

methods.name: hybridSchemaAndComponent
methods.description: Renders custom component if schema specifies one.

methods.name: renderSidebar
methods.description: Renders the sidebar navigation for sections.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders all settings sections and their settings.
